# Minimized floating panes wait as capsules (Rex's taskbar) in a corner of
# the split: each says what runs there; a click brings that one back with
# the keyboard; the corner is a setting (floating-minimized-corner), and a
# drag sets it; its menu's Close is undoable as ⌘W in it is; minimized, it's
# saved with the layout. A capsule never takes the keyboard. Run with
# --persist (the layout is saved by session).
expect-capsules:none
action:new_floating_pane
wait:1.2
expect-floating:1 keyboard
type:echo CAPS-$((40+2))
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:CAPS-42
# Minimized: out of sight, its capsule in the corner (bottom right by
# default), named as its folder (it's at its prompt), the keyboard back in
# the split.
action:toggle_floating_panes
wait:0.4
expect-floating:0
expect-capsules:bottom-right: libertty-ui-probe
expect-focus:1
expect-unlabeled:0 capsules
roundtrip:go
# A click on it: back, in front, with the keyboard; no capsule left.
capsule:1:click
wait:0.5
expect-floating:1 keyboard
expect-capsules:none
type:echo BACK-$((40+3))
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:BACK-43
# Its own Minimize button: the capsule again.
click:Minimize (it keeps running)
wait:0.4
expect-floating:0
expect-capsules:bottom-right: libertty-ui-probe
# The setting moves them (below the pane's header, along the top).
type:libertty +set floating-minimized-corner=top-left
key:enter
wait:1.5
reload:config
wait:0.4
expect-capsules:top-left: libertty-ui-probe
appearance:dark
wait:0.3
expect-capsules:top-left: libertty-ui-probe
appearance:light
wait:0.3
# Dragged to the bottom's middle: they stay there, and it's the setting now.
capsule:drag:bottom-center
wait:0.5
expect-capsules:bottom-center: libertty-ui-probe
expect-shell:grep floating-minimized-corner "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/libertty/config" ==> bottom-center
expect-focus:1
# Its menu's Close: gone, and Edit ▸ Undo brings it back as it was —
# minimized, its shell still running, the keyboard where it is.
capsule:1:close
wait:0.8
expect-capsules:none
expect-undo:Close Pane
undo:go
wait:0.6
expect-capsules:bottom-center: libertty-ui-probe
expect-focus:1
action:toggle_floating_panes
wait:0.4
expect-floating:1 keyboard
type:echo UNDONE-$((40+4))
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:UNDONE-44
# A composer open at the pane's foot: the capsules sit above it, not over
# its buttons; closed, they're back at the foot.
action:toggle_floating_panes
wait:0.4
expect-capsules:bottom-center: libertty-ui-probe
composer:open
wait:0.5
expect-capsules:clear
composer:close
wait:0.5
expect-capsules:clear
